description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is diverse and committed to democratizing access to the global economy through Ledn's products and services.

The core values guiding Ledn are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are looking for motivated individuals to join us as we build, innovate, and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will combine innovation and creative problem solving with adaptability to the ever-changing enterprise infrastructure landscape. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholders across Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who seeks a supportive environment to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of APIs and system integration.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and calmly.
  • Strong ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages; maintain documentation and knowledge articles.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, are sensitive to different cultures, and are committed to providing a magical experience for others. You understand security concepts (PGP, OSI model) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching). You can self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can make decisions with limited data.

  • Strong organizational and task-management skills.
  • Ability to work in a remote environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Experience using GAM and command-line interfaces to improve efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We are looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: adaptability, resilience, empathy, integrity, and accountability. A builder’s mindset, collaborative partner, and the ability to influence across functions are important.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and an inclusive, diverse workplace.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer. For accommodation requests during the recruitment process, you may contact the Ledn team by email. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Ledn is a global, remote-first company with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and reviews of publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes or related fees.

title: Partner Account Manager - Public Sector
description:
Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop key relationships and build scalable programs with our Public Sector distribution and resale partners to drive net new pipeline and accelerate sales outcomes
  • Work with Sales and other cross-functional partners within Samsara to identify opportunities that our partners can accelerate
  • Build a scaled Public Sector channel motion (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Play a role in shaping our Public Sector partnerships strategic roadmap
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5 years of experience in Public Sector partnerships or sales
  • Experience with scaled Public Sector channel motions (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Experience building programs with a history of driving the Public Sector pipeline through partners
  • Kind and collaborative orientation, who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams
  • A builder mentality—you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in B2B technology or within a B2B technology ecosystem
  • Experience working with Carahsoft
  • Experience with common Public Sector contract vehicles used to purchase IT/cloud and/or fleet management solutions

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. $78,926.75 — $132,650 USD

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Benefits

Full time employees receive a competitive total compensation package along with employee-led remote and flexible working, health benefits, and much, much more. Take a look at our Benefits site to learn more.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You$_39;ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.

Qualifications (continued)

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.
  • Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line interfaces; Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Ledn’s core values are act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are remote-first and support a diverse, global team.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate will wear many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and be able to adapt to a fast-moving, security-first environment. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support, owning the employee tech experience via Slack, Jira, and other tools. Responsibilities include procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and provisioning tech for outgoing staff. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoints and MDM/EMM tools. You will also work on identity and access management (IDP/SSO with G Suite, Okta), document solutions, and automate routine tasks.

You will manage incidents, prioritize help desk tickets, and collaborate across teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR). You will work in sprints with Jira and align your objectives and key results with team and company goals.

Responsibilities

  • Provide end-user support and own the employee tech experience (Mac-centric environment).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding hardware responsibilities.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs and policies; contribute to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications: Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management (MDM/EMM) tools (Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO tooling (GSuite, Okta); integrate systems via APIs.
  • Troubleshoot, respond to incidents, and manage help desk tickets with prioritization.
  • Participate in project work over sprints with Agile practices (Jira).
  • Set and pursue own objectives and key results aligned with company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS benchmarks, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO and workflows in Okta; API experience for system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong security consciousness and understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Self-management: ability to scope projects, prioritize, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf or Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Experience in a remote, high-growth startup or tech environment; collaborative, empathetic partner across functions.

Benefits & Environment

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and equity opportunities.
  • Remote-friendly with up to 180 days of remote work worldwide (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse workplace with equal opportunity employment principles.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests during all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn’s team is global and remote-first; short-listed candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and public social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes or fees.

Diferenciais

Requirements and skills

Back-End (.NET Core):

  • Windows Services: Experiência em criar e gerenciar serviços do Windows utilizando .NET, incluindo configuração, instalação e manutenção de serviços que rodam em segundo plano.
  • Web API: Capacidade de criar, manter e documentar APIs RESTful.
  • Segurança: Experiência em implementar autenticação e autorização (por exemplo, JWT, OAuth).
  • Testes Unitários: Familiaridade com frameworks de testes como xUnit ou NUnit para garantir a qualidade do código back-end.

Banco de Dados:

  • SQL Server/PostgreSQL: Habilidade em escrever consultas SQL otimizadas e realizar modelagem de dados.
  • NoSQL: Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL, como MongoDB e REDIS, é um diferencial.

Mensageria:

  • RabbitMQ: Conhecimento em configurar e gerenciar filas, exchanges e bindings para processamento assíncrono de mensagens.
  • Kafka: Experiência com Apache Kafka, incluindo criação e gerenciamento de tópicos, produção e consumo de mensagens, e configuração de clusters.

DevOps e Ferramentas:

  • Controle de Versão (Git): Proficiência em Git para versionamento de código e trabalho colaborativo.
  • Integração Contínua/Entrega Contínua (CI/CD): Experiência em configurar pipelines de CI/CD com ferramentas como Azure DevOps.

Experiência com Distribuição e Sincronização de Dados:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções que sincronizam dados entre diferentes bases de dados, incluindo arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Implementação de estratégias de replicação e distribuição de informações entre múltiplos sistemas.

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de Dados:

  • Design de soluções orientadas a eventos para processamento em tempo real.
  • Uso de filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka) para distribuição de dados.
  • Modelagem de dados para escalabilidade e performance.

Práticas de Segurança de Dados:

  • Implementação de criptografia, controle de acesso e conformidade com normas de segurança de dados (LGPD, GDPR).

Additional information

O que mais você vai encontrar por aqui?

  • Day off: Todas as pessoas terão direito à folga no dia do aniversário

Esses benefícios são combinados na Paschoalotto com oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional, programa estruturado de carreira, acesso as iniciativas de saúde e qualidade de vida, clima descontraído, convivência com pessoas diversas e plurais e espaço para aprendizado e inovação.

The candidate will be recognized for prioritizing and executing key partnership enablement strategies, product training and onboarding, and developing long-term relationships that drive net-new opportunities for Roofr’s revenue team.

The candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders including sales, marketing, operations, and other teams within the partnerships group to deepen Roofr’s partnerships with the roofing supply vertical.

Qualifications

  • Experience in channel partnerships is a plus

  • Experience with CRMs (HubSpot/Salesforce), PRMs (Partner Stack), Asana, Google Suite

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

Who You Are

We are interviewing candidates located in select US states: IN, IL, MN, MI, WI, OH, FL, GA, SC, AL. Compensation Range: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00 base + commission USD.

We support meaningful work with a focus on growth and development. Examples of benefits and programs include:

description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere.

Field Reimbursement Specialists (FRSs) are responsible for providing field support for patient access to client’s specified products through interaction with the client’s patient support program and provider customers.

FRSs provide their expertise and advanced skills to resolve complex patient access and provider reimbursement issues and to provide educational services across a variety of healthcare provider sites of care.

FRSs work directly with the provider and their office support staff and commonly interact with other reimbursement and patient support services provided by clients.

Play a vital role in helping patients gain access to life-changing therapies! From oral medications to biosimilars to critical cancer treatments, our associates, with their passion for patients, represent these therapies providing education, coverage, and access solutions to healthcare personnel.

FRSs will plan and engage with customers, leveraging client-approved resources, to educate on access and reimbursement topics relevant to assigned client’s product.

Our teams travel weekly, which could include overnight, to healthcare offices within a designated territory, using their knowledge of coverage, patient assistance, and health policy to educate office staff and break through access issues to ultimately help patients.

Typical Day:

  • Educate provider office staff and practice managers on logistics needed to support client product, including infrastructure needed to support in-office administration.
  • Educate provider office staff with understanding the payers’ coverage management strategies for product, including coding, billing, formulary, prior authorization, and appeal processes.
  • Probe to understand office processes and ability to discern root causes of access or reimbursement issues.
  • Deliver interactive educational presentations at various provider sites of service.
  • Provide information on relevant reimbursement topics related to our client’s products based on client’s approval.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to conduct field-based reimbursement and access support, education, and consultation to key account customers and cross-functional partners.
  • Understands the dynamics of Specialty Pharmacy vs. Specialty Distribution.
  • Broad understanding of the physician buy-and-bill model vs. assignment of benefits to alternate sites of care.
  • Experience in revenue cycle, buy and bill, formulary, benefit investigations, prior authorization, coding, and appeals processes.
  • Deep understanding of medical and pharmacy benefits/policies.
  • Live within a reasonable commuting distance of a major airport in the listed location and be able to travel within a territory that includes but may not be limited to MN, WI, IL.

Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Bachelor's degree or specific Practice Management experience preferred.
  • Project management skills.
  • Experience with extensive travel.

The role reports to the Director of IT and involves working closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams such as Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This is a customer-facing, first-line support role where you own the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We are a Mac environment.

Responsibilities

  • Be the first line of support for employees; own support experience via Slack, Jira, and related tools.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Mac endpoints; procure and deliver technology equipment; onboard new employees and retrieve equipment from departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM/Jamf).
  • Improve identity and access management (IDP/SSO) integrations (GSuite, Okta).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents and issues to completion; prioritize help desk tickets and balance them with project work.
  • Contribute to projects using agile methods and sprints (Jira); set and track objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across teams and maintain customer-focused IT service delivery.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, and similar languages.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to handle shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to craft clear help articles; ability to manage projects and self-direct priorities.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model).
  • Self-management and ability to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfortable navigating ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to haves: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM/command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

You may reach out for accommodation requests at any stage of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group from diverse backgrounds with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building and revolutionizing financial services and invite you to join us.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will need to be highly motivated, dependable, and an experienced technologist who collaborates with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT.

This role is customer-facing and serves as the first line of support for employees via channels such as Slack and Jira. You will manage procurement and delivery of technology equipment, oversee tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing staff, and develop programs, policies and tools. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta) and document solutions with help articles and automation. You will manage incidents and prioritize help desk tickets, work on projects over sprints, and align objectives with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. and to utilize open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Exceptional communication skills across media; clear writing in tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures; a mindset to provide a magical user experience; emphasis on security (understanding PGP) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams; strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable with ambiguity.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to improve efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We seek a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.
  • Adaptable and resilient, with a builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner able to influence across functions with empathy and clarity; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one, including competitive PTO and equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote work flexibility: opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and a team focused on reducing barriers to doing great work.

title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Overview

Information Technology Manager role at LEDN . Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who need assistance. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). This role reports to the Director of IT.

Overview of the role includes customer-facing responsibilities as the first line of support and ownership of the support experience for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira. We primarily operate on macOS in our environment and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to our knowledge base. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and document solutions, help articles, and automated workflows. You will manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents, balance help desk tickets, and participate in projects across sprints using Jira and agile methods.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open-source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta. Knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Exceptional communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and support users who are time-poor or frustrated.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack communications.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching) and OSI model layers; methodical troubleshooting approach.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit : We value leadership that thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values of progress, integrity, collaboration and empathy. A builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; ability to influence across functions; and a track record of integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.

The Benefits We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package that starts on day one, including a competitive PTO package.
  • Equity ownership via shared equity, giving employees a stake in the company.
  • Remote-ready work arrangements, with up to 180 days remote work worldwide (subject to restrictions).

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process, please email the Ledn team. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Location : Blumenau, Blumenau area, Brazil and other global locations. We are remote-first and may contact only qualified applicants due to high volume. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available relevant social media activity. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

We are seeking a Manager of IT who will wear multiple hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.   • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and respond to issues through to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects in sprints (Jira, agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows; strong API skills for system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; hardware shipping and customs experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching), and OSI model steps.
  • Self-management skills to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams; strong organizational skills.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace).
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with a values-driven approach; remote work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package, starting on day one; comprehensive benefits and PTO.
  • Equity ownership in the company; opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role in a global digital asset company; inclusive, diverse culture; accommodation support during recruitment.

Additional Information

  • Ledn operates as a remote-first company with a global team across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume applications, only qualified candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; public social media review may be conducted. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role Details

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You'll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to have certifications).
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to work efficiently.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, is excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company; through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the future.
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Additional Information

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Our team is global and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable, creative in problem solving, and able to work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We predominantly work on macOS, and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools. You will detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix incidents as needed. You will work on projects over sprints, and document your work in Jira. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of API integrations between systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear, friendly, and concise writing.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, macOS enterprise configuration, and technical onboarding/offboarding processes.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically.
  • Self-management with clear scoping of projects and priorities across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit : You thrive in a startup/tech environment, value integrity and accountability, and can influence across functions with empathy and clarity. Experience working in a remote environment is a plus.

Overview

Senior Graphic Designer (Contract) at Pocket Worlds. Remote location for LATAM candidates.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Graphic Designer with a strong background in digital art and illustration. You will be responsible for creating high-quality in-app promotional materials, social media content, and marketing creatives using our product’s avatars and digital assets. The ideal candidate has senior-level experience in digital asset creation, strong compositing skills, and a versatile portfolio that demonstrates range, consistency, and professional quality across styles. This role requires both creativity and adaptability—you should bring an AI-forward mindset, be eager to explore and leverage AI tools, and maintain polished, professional outputs without relying on obvious AI work. We’re looking for someone collaborative, low ego, and excited to iterate based on feedback to align with brand vision.

Location & Team

Location: Remote — LATAM
Team: Live Operations

Contract

The position is a contract role with an initial one-month period, with the possibility of renewal and extension based on performance and business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Create compelling digital visuals by styling and posing in-game assets.

  • Create reusable templates for in-app promotions and campaigns.
  • Innovate new approaches to presenting promotions and seasonal content.
  • Collaborate closely with art, product, and live operations teams to deliver creative solutions.
  • Manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment to consistently meet deadlines.

  • Stay current with digital design trends and incorporate them thoughtfully into your work.

Requirements

  • Senior-level experience as a graphic designer or digital artist.

  • Expertise in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Proven ability in character styling, lighting, effects, backgrounds, and mood/expressions.
  • Strong foundation in drawing, anatomy, perspective, and color theory.
  • Demonstrated skill in adapting to client/brand vision and iterating based on feedback.
  • Collaborative, low-ego approach with excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Self-driven with strong organizational and time management abilities.

Bonuses

  • Passion for fashion design.
  • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and experience creating 2D animated promotional videos.
  • Experience with video editing.
  • Background in character art.

The position will start with an initial 1-month contract period, with the possibility of renewal and extension based on performance and business needs.

Responsabilidades

  • Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Dados & Governança com sólida experiência em arquitetura de soluções, liderança técnica e governança corporativa em ambientes de dados modernos.
  • O(a) profissional terá como missão definir e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis em plataformas Lakehouse, promover boas práticas de governança e DataOps e atuar como líder estratégico para times técnicos e de negócio, conectando dados a valor corporativo em escala global.

Arquitetura De Soluções

  • Projetar arquiteturas Lakehouse modernas, utilizando plataformas como Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Lakehouse Federation).
  • Definir padrões de ingestão e transformação (batch, streaming, eventos) com Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Liquid Clustering.
  • Modelar dados em arquiteturas Medallion (Raw, Silver, Gold), incluindo camadas de consumo (serving, APIs, BI, ML).
  • Estruturar integrações com sistemas legados, SaaS, SAP, DMS, ERPs e aplicações corporativas.
  • Apoiar projetos de Data Mesh e domínios de dados, com foco em escalabilidade e ownership.
  • Conectar dados a Analytics, Data Science e GenAI, viabilizando casos de uso avançados (predição, recomendação, copilots).
  • Avaliar e recomendar padrões arquiteturais (streaming-first, event-driven, real-time analytics).
  • Conduzir design reviews e provas de conceito para novas soluções de dados.
  • Apoiar estratégias de custo otimizado (compute, storage, caching, auto-scaling).
  • Documentar e disseminar blueprints corporativos de arquitetura de dados.

Governança e Estratégia

  • Definir e operacionalizar frameworks de Data Governance corporativa (catálogo, glossário, lineage, ownership, stewardship, qualidade).
  • Implantar políticas de segurança, privacidade e compliance (LGPD, GDPR, HIPAA), incluindo anonimização e criptografia.
  • Estabelecer políticas de classificação de dados (sensibilidade, retenção, criticidade) aplicadas em catálogos e camadas de dados.
  • Conduzir avaliações de maturidade em governança de dados e elaborar roadmaps de evolução. Apoiar o desenho e execução de modelos operacionais de governança (Hub & Spoke, centralizado, federado).
  • Introduzir automações de governança com Unity Catalog, AI/GenAI para classificação, lineage automático e sugestão de glossário.
  • Conduzir processos de definição de ownership e stewardship com áreas de negócio.
  • Estabelecer métricas e KPIs de governança (cobertura de catálogo, nível de qualidade, adoção de glossário, acessos).
  • Apoiar iniciativas de AI Governance, incluindo catalogação e ciclo de vida de modelos.
  • Atuar como ponte entre times de negócio, segurança e engenharia, garantindo adoção e alinhamento corporativo.

Liderança Técnica

  • Atuar como referência técnica e arquitetural, orientando engenheiros, analistas e cientistas.
  • Conduzir revisões de arquitetura e propor blueprints de dados corporativos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e executivos.

DataOps e Automação

  • Implementar CI/CD de dados com GitLab/GitHub, Terraform e Databricks Asset Bundles.
  • Garantir qualidade de dados com testes automatizados (DQX, Pytest, SQLFluff).
  • Apoiar práticas de MLOps com MLflow, Feature Store e monitoramento de modelos.
  • Explorar uso de GenAI e automação inteligente em governança e qualidade.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de dados moderna (Lakehouse, Medallion).
  • Sólida atuação em Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Federation).
  • Domínio em Python para pipelines e automações.
  • Vivência prática em ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, Azure).
  • Conhecimento em Data Governance, segurança e compliance.

Soft Skills

  • Comunicação executiva clara, traduzindo complexidade técnica em decisões de negócio.

title: Analista de Dados PL - aiqfome
description:
Sobre nós

O Magalu é uma das maiores empresas de varejo do Brasil, reconhecida por sua inovação e presença digital. Com mais de 60 anos de história, conecta milhões de clientes por meio das lojas e de uma plataforma multicanal, oferecendo produtos e serviços de qualidade. A empresa investe continuamente em transformação digital, tecnologia e diversidade, criando um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Nós representamos uma macro-área de Data Analytics. Nosso time é dividido por pessoas com perfis variados de dados (Analistas de Dados, Engenheiros de Dados, Cientistas, Business Analytics, etc) e também por pessoas com perfil atuante em Pricing, Finanças, Produto e Planejamento Estratégico. Nossa função é navegar por todas as BU's da vertical (grand chef, plus delivery, aiqfome) e conseguir entregar recomendações de negócios baseadas no que os dados estão nos dizendo, para isso, você estará diariamente em contato com times de Marketing, Vendas, Produto, e Tecnologia.

  • Somos uma área que tem por objetivo evangelizar a cultura de dados e experimentação;
  • Faremos estudos de eficiência, apontaremos caminhos e compartilharemos aprendizados;
  • Somos um time aficcionado pelo nosso usuário: seja ele o fominha, seller, CM, indústria ou fomer;
  • Criaremos uma plataforma de dados robusta, com automatização, dashboards e modelos de AI;
  • Se você precisa fazer a mesma coisa todo dia/semana, você precisa automatiza-la.

Descrição do Cargo

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Liderança na Estratégia e Coleta de Dados: Liderar a identificação, avaliação e extração de dados de fontes complexas e variadas (bancos de dados, APIs, data lakes), definindo as melhores práticas e garantindo a integridade e relevância dos dados para as análises estratégicas.
  • Modelagem e Governança de Dados: Desenvolver e implementar processos robustos de limpeza, transformação e modelagem de dados, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e governança das informações em toda a empresa.
  • Análise Preditiva e Diagnóstica: Conduzir análises complexas, incluindo modelagem estatística, testes de hipóteses e análises preditivas, para diagnosticar tendências, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e prever cenários futuros.
  • Desenvolvimento e Liderança de Dashboards Estratégicos: Projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar dashboards e relatórios estratégicos para a alta gestão, focando em KPIs que direcionem o desempenho do negócio e facilitem a tomada de decisão em tempo real.
  • Parceria Estratégica com Áreas de Negócio: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico para as lideranças, compreendendo profundamente suas necessidades e traduzindo desafios de negócio em projetos de dados que gerem valor e impacto mensurável.
  • Otimização e Arquitetura de Consultas: Elaborar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em grandes volumes de dados.
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura e performance dos bancos de dados analíticos.
  • Automação e Escalabilidade de Processos: Liderar a automação de pipelines de dados e processos analíticos, utilizando ferramentas de ETL/ELT para aumentar a eficiência, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das nossas operações de dados.
  • Comunicação e Influência: Comunicar insights e recomendações de forma clara e persuasiva para audiências diversas, incluindo executivos e stakeholders não técnicos, influenciando a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Mentoria e Desenvolvimento da Equipe: Atuar como mentor para analistas de dados júnior e pleno, compartilhando conhecimento, promovendo as melhores práticas e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico e analítico da equipe.
  • Inovação e Pesquisa: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, metodologias e abordagens em análise de dados e machine learning, mantendo a empresa na vanguarda das práticas do mercado.
  • Precisamos Que Você Tenha
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em áreas relacionadas a dados será considerado um diferencial.
  • Proficiência em SQL (MySQL e Google BigQuery): Experiência avançada na criação e otimização de consultas complexas.
  • Conhecimento em Window Functions, CTEs (Common Table Expressions) e boas práticas para performance e controle de custos em ambientes de nuvem.
  • Expertise em Ferramentas de BI (Power BI e Looker Studio): Domínio completo de pelo menos uma das ferramentas (preferencialmente ambas) para criar dashboards complexos, interativos e de alto impacto.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados (DAX no Power BI) e integração de múltiplas fontes de dados.
  • Programação em Python para Análise de Dados: Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experiência na automação de processos, manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e integração com APIs.
  • Conhecimento Estatístico Aplicado: Sólida compreensão de conceitos estatísticos e sua aplicação prática em negócios (testes A/B, análise de regressão, testes de hipóteses) para validar resultados e gerar insights mais profundos.
  • Google Workspace (Planilhas e Apresentações): Habilidade para ir além do uso básico, utilizando Google Sheets para análises rápidas e prototipagem, e Google Slides para comunicar resultados complexos de forma clara e persuasiva para a liderança.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos complexos com autonomia.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborativo com times multidisciplinares.
  • Comunicação: Clareza ao traduzir requisitos técnicos para não técnicos.

  • Provide customer-facing IT support; own support channels via Slack, Jira, etc.; manage Mac endpoints and enterprise macOS deployments.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience using GAM and CLI tools; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with values alignment.

Benefits and What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity; remote work eligibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first environment. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

description:
Overview

Arquiteto de Segurança - Especialista, remoto/BR, na Projectiva Holding. Somos uma holding com empresas especializadas, entregando valor sob medida para cada desafio em transformação digital, inovação, ERP ou desenvolvimento. Buscamos um profissional para integrar o time com foco em soluções de segurança robustas e conformes às melhores práticas e regulamentações.

O que buscamos: um profissional com visão estratégica de segurança para colaborar com times de software, infraestrutura e operações, contribuindo com a melhoria contínua da postura de segurança da organização.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de segurança: projetar e garantir a implementação de arquiteturas de segurança robustas e escaláveis para aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes Multi Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), alinhadas com as melhores práticas de mercado e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Apoiar no design seguro de sistemas: trabalhar com Arquitetos de Software e equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar segurança desde as etapas iniciais do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (Secure SDLC), realizando análises de ameaças (Threat Modeling) e revisões de design.
  • Garantir a segurança em ambientes Cloud e Contêineres: implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para plataformas Cloud (principalmente GCP, incluindo GKE, Cloud SQL), redes (VPCs, firewalls, micro-segmentação) e ambientes conteinerizados (Kubernetes), assegurando conformidade e proteção de dados.
  • Promover a cultura DevSecOps: colaborar para a integração de práticas de segurança nas esteiras de CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA, image scanning), automatizando verificações e garantindo deployments seguros por design.
  • Gerenciar Identidade e Acesso: projetar e implementar soluções de IAM, autenticação forte (MFA, SSO) e gestão de segredos para assegurar o princípio do menor privilégio.
  • Assegurar conformidade e auditoria: atuar para que as soluções estejam em conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas (ex: LGPD, Bacen para clientes do setor financeiro), preparando ambientes para auditorias de segurança.
  • Documentar e disseminar conhecimento: criar e manter documentação técnica de segurança, padrões e guidelines, e atuar como referência para o time em decisões técnicas de segurança.
  • Visão estratégica e melhoria contínua: contribuir com a visão estratégica de segurança, identificar tendências e novas ameaças, propondo melhorias para a postura de segurança dos ambientes.

Qualificações / Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em Arquitetura de Segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento profundo em plataformas Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), com foco em serviços de segurança nativos (ex: Security Command Center, Security Hub, GuardDuty, WAF).
  • Domínio de Kubernetes Security (RBAC, Network Policies, image scanning, runtime security).
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e integração de segurança no pipeline de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10, Zero Trust).
  • Conhecimento em IAM, gestão de segredos, criptografia e proteção de dados.
  • Habilidade para Threat Modeling e análise de riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de segurança (ex: CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, GCP Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
  • Experiência em segmentação de rede, VPNs e SD-WAN para ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de segurança como SIEM/SOAR, CSPM e Vulnerability Scanners.
  • Experiência com automação de segurança via scripting (Python, Shell).
  • Histórico de atuação em clientes do setor financeiro e familiaridade com Bacen e LGPD.

O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de crescimento e aprendizado contínuo
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
  • Contratação PJ ou Cooperado
  • DayOff no mês de aniversário
