title: Técnico de telecomunicações
description:
Resumo

O Técnico(a) em Telecomunicações ou Técnico(a) em Redes de Computadores é responsável por manter sistemas de telecomunicações e infraestrutura de rede, assegurando a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança dos serviços de comunicação de dados e voz. Atua na configuração de equipamentos de rede, rádios, modems celulares, terminais satelitais e servidores de comunicação, garantindo conectividade local e remota.

Esse profissional desempenha papel essencial no suporte e manutenção da infraestrutura de redes corporativas, realizando diagnósticos, testes de desempenho, ajustes de configuração e registrando incidentes para garantir a continuidade operacional.

Responsabilidades

  • Manter sistemas de telecomunicações e infraestrutura de rede para assegurar disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança.
  • Configurar equipamentos de rede, rádios, modems celulares, terminais satelitais e servidores de comunicação.
  • Realizar diagnósticos, testes de desempenho, ajustes de configuração e registrar incidentes para garantir a continuidade operacional.

Conhecimentos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento básico em plataformas de monitoramento (ex.: Zabbix).
  • Conhecimento básico em plataformas de gestão de chamados (ex.: OTRS, ServiceNow, etc.).
  • Conhecimento básico em plataformas de visualização de dados (ex.: Grafana, Power BI, etc.).
  • Conhecimento básico em práticas de Cibersegurança e Segurança da Informação.
  • Nível básico em Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experiência anterior na área de TI e/ou central de monitoramento e incidentes/problemas (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos, automação, proteção e medição (desejável).
  • Conhecimentos técnicos desejados:
  • Sistemas de Telecomunicações: princípios básicos de transmissão de dados e voz, multiplexação, enlaces de rádio, satélite e celular.
  • Configuração de rádios: ajuste de frequências, largura de banda, potência, polarização e alinhamento de antenas.
  • Modelo OSI: entendimento das camadas físicas, de enlace, rede, transporte e aplicação, aplicando conceitos em troubleshooting.
  • Configuração de equipamentos de rede:
  • Switches: criação e gerenciamento de VLANs, configuração de STP, portas trunk e access.
  • Roteadores: configuração de rotas estáticas, protocolos de roteamento dinâmico (OSPF, BGP básico).
  • Terminal Server: configuração de acesso remoto seguro e tunelamento.
  • Modems celulares e satelitais: configuração de APNs, endereçamento IP, failover e redundância de links.
  • Segurança de rede: noções de firewall, ACLs e VPNs.

description:
We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and enjoys helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, and be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do / Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support via channels like Slack and Jira, delivering an outstanding experience for employees. All team members are on macOS.
  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment; owning the onboarding experience for new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate recurring tasks. Manage and resolve critical incidents and issues as needed, from inception to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets and prioritize effectively; work on projects over sprints and document work in Jira (familiar with Agile methods and sprints).
  • Set and work toward personal objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; know-how to work with APIs and integrate systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of shipping/receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; ability to explain ideas clearly and assist users who may be frustrated or time-poor;
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication, sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with knowledge of PGP; understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); methodical OSI-model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across teams.

Nice to Haves Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit We look for a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values: integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy; able to work in a remote environment and influence across functions with clarity and empathy.

The Offer / What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and opportunity for remote work worldwide up to 180 days.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company via equity; built-in opportunities for remote work and travel flexibility.
  • A purpose-driven role with a focus on inclusion, diversity, and equal opportunity employment.

Ledn is a global, remote-first company with teams across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may contact shortlisted candidates for a short video response. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected status.

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Manual Tester to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in ensuring the quality and reliability of our applications by verifying functionality against detailed specifications. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in the software development lifecycle by designing, executing, and managing comprehensive manual test plans and cases. Working closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts, the Senior Manual Tester will help deliver robust, defect-free software solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Building, modifying, and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and scripts to validate application functionality. This includes covering both positive and negative scenarios to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Identifying, reporting, and tracking defects through to closure using Azure DevOps Test Plan features. Collaborate with development teams to prioritize and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Actively participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Review requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and testability.
  • Work closely with QA leads, developers, and business analysts to understand business needs and technical requirements, ensuring alignment and quality delivery.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of test cases, test results, and defect reports to support transparency and traceability.
  • Perform thorough manual testing to validate new features and existing functionality, ensuring the software meets business and technical requirements.
  • While primarily focused on manual testing, understand automated test script execution and results to complement manual efforts and improve overall test coverage.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Contribute to process improvements in testing methodologies, tools, and best practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality.
  • SQL: Proficient in writing complex SQL queries to validate data integrity and support backend testing. Ability to analyze and manipulate data sets to verify application behavior.
  • Oracle PL/SQL: Strong experience with Oracle PL/SQL for database testing, including writing and executing stored procedures, functions, and triggers to validate business logic at the database level.
  • Microsoft Excel: Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, particularly with functions like VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP, to analyze test data, compare results, and generate reports efficiently.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Test Plan features for managing test cases, executing tests, logging defects, and tracking progress within an Agile environment.
  • Manual Testing: Expertise in manual functional testing, including designing test cases, executing tests, and validating application features against requirements.
  • Functional Testing: Deep understanding of functional testing principles to ensure that software behaves as expected under various conditions.
  • Scrum: Active participation in Agile Scrum ceremonies, with a solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the ability to work effectively in iterative development cycles.
  • Defect Management: Skilled in identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects to resolution, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ultra Edit: Familiarity with Ultra Edit or similar advanced text editors to review and analyze code snippets, logs, or configuration files during testing.
  • PeopleSoft HCM: Experience with PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, understanding core modules and workflows to better test related applications.
  • Benefits Module: Knowledge of Benefits modules within PeopleSoft or similar HR systems to validate features related to employee benefits administration.
  • Payroll Module: Understanding of Payroll modules and processes to effectively test payroll-related functionalities and integrations.

Job Description

Candidates must be fluent in English and submit their application in English to be considered.

Only those currently living in and authorized to work in Brazil are eligible. The application system will store candidate information. Once submitted, application details will be shared with Church Education System (CES) partners involved in the selection process. Applicants may receive a rejection email during or after review; however, unless a direct rejection is received from the hiring manager, applications will remain active and under consideration.

Responsibilities

  • The Computer Programming Course Instructor is an important part of the instructional team. With a strong focus on the academic success of every student, instructors use their subject matter expertise, deep understanding of the curriculum, and student population to:
  • Identify trends impeding academic success.
  • Conduct targeted outreach and provide instruction to target groups and individuals.
  • Build capable learners, confident in their ability to succeed academically and in life.
  • Instructors do not develop lessons or assessments, nor do they issue grades on student work (grading is handled by a centrally managed pool of qualified Graders).
  • Their focus is on the academic success of every student in their care.

Important: This is a part-time work-from-home position with the following flexible schedule:

  • 10-12 hours per week (may vary week-to-week)
  • At least 5 days worked each week
  • Required attendance at periodic team meetings (as established by the department)

Course Description

Teaching and mentoring students (using Python and C#) for:

  • CSE 110 - Introduction to Programming
  • CSE 111 - Programming with Functions
  • CSE 210 - Programming with Classes
  • CSE 212 - Programming with Data Structures

These courses provide students with foundational computer programming skills, enabling them to contribute to software development teams.

Position Summary

BYU Pathway and BYU Idaho online courses are structured to include both an instructor and graders. Instructors are responsible for teaching and overall course delivery, while graders support the learning process by reviewing and evaluating assignments and providing students with constructive feedback. We are seeking instructors who will apply their skills and subject matter expertise to mentor students and facilitate teaching/learning experiences.

Qualifications

NOTE : An applicant’s résumé and official transcripts will be used to determine eligibility to serve as an instructor for the Computer Programming courses. Please clearly highlight relevant education, professional work, and technologies on your résumé.

General Instructor Requirements

  • Deep understanding of and commitment to BYU Pathway Worldwide’s mission, defining characteristics, and student population.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (required).
  • Adaptability to new processes, procedures, and technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: professional, respectful, and unbiased in sensitive situations.
  • Proven reliability and ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, video conferencing, and discipline-specific software.
  • Experience with online teaching/learning, especially with at-risk learners (preferred).

Specific Course Requirements: Computer Programming

  • A master’s degree in computer science or a related field and two years of professional software development experience is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of work experience may be considered.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or Java is required.
  • Expert proficiency with basic programming concepts, such as variables, data types, collections, loops, functions, libraries, I/O, error handling, and testing.
  • Expert proficiency with basic object-oriented programming concepts, such as classes, methods, variables, and access modifiers.
  • Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
  • Understanding object-oriented principles, such as abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, and inheritance.
  • Experience with version control software, such as GitHub.
  • Experience with code editors, such as Visual Studio Code.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing.

Additional Documentation Requirement

Candidates advancing to the next stage of the hiring process will be required to provide the following academic documents:

  • Official transcript (histórico escolar) of a completed bachelor’s or master’s degree. The transcript must be sent directly from the awarding institution, either in digital or physical format. Transcripts submitted by the candidate, regardless of format, will not be considered official for accreditation or academic credential verification purposes. This process may take time and may involve additional expenses, depending on the institution.
  • Copy of diploma (front and back) showing the date of degree completion or the date of the graduation/commencement ceremony (data da colação de grau).

Academic documents issued by Brazilian or international institutions are acceptable, provided they are officially recognized in Brazil and the country of origin (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional). Not applicable: in-progress transcripts and associate-level degrees. A completed bachelor’s degree is the minimum requirement for this position.

Documentação Adicional Requerida

Os Candidatos Que Avançarem Para a Próxima Etapa Do Processo Seletivo Deverão Apresentar Os Seguintes Documentos Acadêmicos

  • Histórico escolar oficial de bacharelado ou mestrado concluído.

  • Históricos enviados pelo próprio candidato, independentemente do formato, não serão considerados oficiais para fins de credenciamento ou verificação de títulos acadêmicos.
  • Observe que este processo pode demandar tempo e gerar custos adicionais.

Serão aceitos documentos acadêmicos emitidos por instituições brasileiras ou estrangeiras, desde que reconhecidos oficialmente no Brasil e no país de origem (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional).

  • Regional leadership training, guidance, and mentorship.

Annual Base Pay: $100,000 - $120,000* + competitive annual bonus plan + true equity ownership in the clinic (more skin in the game!)

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to build and grow a successful clinic.
  • Strong work ethic and determination to establish community presence and referral relationships.
  • Graduate of an accredited physical therapy program; licensed in the state of practice.
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical experience; supervisory experience preferred.
  • Proven clinical, management, and leadership abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to foster a positive environment with clients and staff.

title: Finance Transformation Automation Associate
description:
Finance Transformation Automation Associate

Join to apply for the Finance Transformation Automation Associate role at dLocal

Overview

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives.

What’s the opportunity?

  • We are seeking a Finance Transformation Automation Associate to drive the automation of financial and operational reconciliations. This role involves integrating data sources from banks and processors (APIs, SFTP, email), standardizing controls, and systematizing variance analysis to accelerate closes and reduce rework. The role blends financial–operational knowledge with skills in data ingestion services, and secure connectivity to move and validate data at scale. Success requires strong proficiency in Excel, familiarity with SQL and Python, and a strong focus on continuous improvement in an agile, fast-paced environment.

What will I be doing?

  • Integrate and maintain data sources from banks/processors via APIs, SFTP, and email workflows, ensuring data quality, completeness, and traceability
  • Execute and improve reconciliation controls for the different types of transactions supported by dashboards, matching rules, and audit evidence
  • Prepare and cleanse inputs (reconcilable groups, rules, sweeps), coordinating adjustments and new implementations with responsible teams
  • Analyze variances and differences across banks, processors, and internal records; conduct root-cause analysis and propose remedial actions and automation solutions
  • Develop analytical models (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query/Power Pivot, or equivalent) for KPIs, variance monitoring, and control tracking
  • Manage tickets and workflows in Jira for new reconciliations, rule/sweep changes, file uploads/removals, following strong documentation practices
  • Collaborate with Business Assurance, Operations, Treasury, Accounting, Product, and Data to resolve incidents, capture requirements, and coordinate UAT for new integrations
  • Standardize SOPs, strengthen controls, and scale end-to-end automations to reduce manual work, and rework during closes
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously in an agile context: gathering requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, performing UAT, and managing change

What skills do I need?

  • 2-4+ years in Finance Transformation, Treasury, Finance Operations, Engineering, or Process Automation, ideally within payments, fintech, or banking
  • Advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience with SQL, Python and automation, with a track record of implementing tech-driven solutions
  • Experience with data ingestion and secure connectivity: APIs, SFTP, CSV/JSON; familiarity with VPN and SSH keys
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, ability to context-switch across multiple projects
  • Growth mindset with high adaptability, comfort with change, and an agile way of working
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent in spoken and written English

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe*
  • Flexibility: flexible schedules and performance-driven culture
  • Fintech industry: dynamic environment with opportunities to build and boost creativity
  • Referral bonus program: employees can refer candidates and earn rewards
  • Learning & development: Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: monthly budget to engage with your team
  • dLocal Houses: option to rent a house and work remotely with your team
  • Location note: for Montevideo-based roles, attendance requirement at the office is 55% (not applicable to IT and Fraud roles)

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you posted by email at every step of the process.

Additional information

Overview

Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is diverse and values integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. We are seeking a full-time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

The role involves working across JavaScript/TypeScript services, an AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices. You will evolve our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches and design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated environments.

The Opportunity

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.

  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.

Nice To Haves

  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

The Ideal Candidate Will

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
The Ledn team is seeking a full-time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Overview

About The Role

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities as one of the world’s leading digital asset companies.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package that starts on your first day, including PTO and ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers to doing great work.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team with accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: We are a global, remote-first team with members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will also design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

What You Will Do

Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).

  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.

O programa conecta jovens a oportunidades de trabalho em empresas ao redor do mundo. Além da atuação profissional, você viverá uma imersão cultural e desenvolverá competências técnicas, de liderança e comunicação intercultural .

A AIESEC , presente em mais de 100 países e 6 continentes, é uma organização sem fins lucrativos, gerida por jovens e dedicada a desenvolver liderança e gerar impacto positivo no mundo .
